tools.name: amazon_search
tools.description: Search Amazon by keyword and get typed product rows: ASIN, title, brand, price, list price, discount %, rating, review count, Prime, sponsored flag, URL. 9 marketplaces. Takes 30-120 s.

tools.name: amazon_product
tools.description: Look up 1-5 Amazon products by ASIN (e.g. "B0CRMZHDG8") and get current price, list price, rating, review count, Prime and URL. Returns only rows whose ASIN matches.

tools.name: ebay_search
tools.description: Search live eBay listings by keyword: title, price, shipping, condition, buying format (auction / Buy It Now), bids, seller, item id, URL. 8 eBay sites. Takes 20-90 s.

tools.name: ebay_seller
tools.description: List the active listings of one eBay seller (store username): titles, prices, condition, format, item ids. Useful for competitor monitoring. Takes 20-90 s.

tools.name: china_sourcing
tools.description: Find factory / wholesale offers for a product on 1688.com and AliExpress: price converted to USD, MOQ, supplier, sales, translated title, URL. English keywords are fine. Takes 10-60 s.

tools.name: rakuten_search
tools.description: Search Rakuten Ichiba (Japan) products: name, price in JPY, shop, review score and count, point rate, URL. Japanese or English keywords. Takes 10-60 s.

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Show how many credits (results) this license key has used this month and how many are left. Free.
